annotations.title: Look Up B2B Tax Invoice & Custody Certificate

description: Generate a formal B2B tax invoice (with buyer PO and company metadata) plus the SHA-256 Chain-of-Custody & Zero-Retention Certificate for a job_id. Call for corporate accounting, P-card expensing, or compliance auditing after job creation or payment. Requires job_id; returns JSON invoice_number, line_items, and chain_of_custody_sha256. Example: job_id='job_01', po_number='PO-104'.

company_name.description: Optional legal entity or corporate buyer name for invoice.

customer_email.description: Billing or engineering email address associated with the order.

job_id.description: Target compilation job identifier for B2B invoice lookup.

po_number.description: Optional corporate Purchase Order number for invoice header.

name: calligraphy_lookup_b2b_invoice
title: Look Up B2B Tax Invoice & Custody Certificate
